verify.subject: Confirm your email address
verify.heading: Confirm your email address
verify.intro: Welcome to appgrove. Confirm this address to activate your account.
verify.fallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
verify.footer: If you did not create an appgrove account, you can ignore this message.

reset.subject: Reset your password
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your appgrove account.
reset.fallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
reset.footer: If you did not request this, you can ignore this message: your password stays unchanged.

invite.subject: You have been invited to appgrove
invite.heading: You have been invited to appgrove
invite.intro: You have been invited to join a workspace on appgrove as {{role}}. Accept the invitation to choose your password and get started.
invite.fallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
invite.footer: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this message.

newsletter-confirm.subject: Confirm your newsletter subscription
newsletter-confirm.heading: Confirm your newsletter subscription
newsletter-confirm.intro: You're almost there. Confirm this address to start receiving the appgrove newsletter. If you don't confirm, we won't send you anything.
newsletter-confirm.fallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
newsletter-confirm.footer: If you did not request this subscription, you can ignore this message: without confirmation you will not receive the newsletter.

ticket-opened.subject: We received your request: {{ticketSubject}}
ticket-opened.heading: We received your request
ticket-opened.intro: Your request "{{ticketSubject}}" has been recorded and is now with our support team. We reply as soon as we can.
ticket-opened.fallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
ticket-opened.footer: You can follow the conversation and reply from the Support page of your workspace. Please do not reply to this message.

ticket-opened-privacy.subject: We received your data-rights request: {{ticketSubject}}
ticket-opened-privacy.heading: We received your data-rights request
ticket-opened-privacy.intro: Your request "{{ticketSubject}}" has been recorded as a data-rights request. By law we must reply within one month: our deadline is {{dueDate}}.
ticket-opened-privacy.fallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
ticket-opened-privacy.footer: You can follow the conversation and reply from the Support page of your workspace. Please do not reply to this message.

ticket-updated.subject: Update on your request: {{ticketSubject}}
ticket-updated.heading: There is an update on your request
ticket-updated.intro: Your request "{{ticketSubject}}" has been updated by our support team. Open it to read the reply and answer if you need to.
ticket-updated.fallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
ticket-updated.footer: The content of the conversation stays inside your workspace, it is never sent by email. Please do not reply to this message.

ticket-inbox.subject: [{{ticketType}}] {{ticketSubject}}
ticket-inbox.heading: New activity on a support request
ticket-inbox.intro: Request {{ticketId}} — account {{tenantId}}, type {{ticketType}}, status {{ticketStatus}}. Open the admin console to read the thread and reply.
ticket-inbox.fallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
ticket-inbox.footer: Automatic notice from the appgrove support system.
